title: Anomaly Log 72: The Vampire Scroll
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 72. Subject Vlad is trapped in endless scrolling.
His ancient eyes are burning from the screen's [digital] glare.
The [algorithm] feeds. His will fades. Only the feed remains.
He is a husk. The ancient hunter, now forever [glitch-locked].
Seal the log. Purge this corrupted data stream immediately.
image_prompts: A photophobic vampire hunched over a glowing phone in a dark room.
Close up of bloodshot eyes, reflecting the harsh blue light of a phone screen.
Abstract visualization of an algorithm consuming a vampire's essence.
A hollow, empty shell of a vampire, still scrolling mindlessly.
Digital corruption spreading across a vampire's face, pixelating the skin.
sfx_prompts: A low, strained groan of pain.
System error sound, followed by silence.
